Utilities (included, not a charge):
- "Water, Recycling & Trash Included"
- "The Mill provides free water, sewer, trash removal, and recycling"

[From https://www.blacksburgmill.com/faq/]
- "The rent and deposit rate is per apartment, not per roommate."
- "The lease agreement will reflect the total rent amount, divided into 12 equal installments due August 1 – July 1."
- "These installments do not represent a monthly rent amount and are not prorated."
- "Residents are responsible for their electricity which is to be contracted through American Electric Power."
- "The Mill is wired for high-speed internet and cable through Xfinity."
- "The Mill has open parking for you and your guests. No parking pass required."
- "The Mill does not charge a standard redecoration fee."
- "The Mill's preferred vendor offers discounted carpet cleaning prices payable by residents who request it."
- "The Mill has 24-hour lock-out services for our residents. Service fees may apply after office hours."
notes: Managed by Weisz Properties, LLC according to listings. The text combines two official pages: floor plans (primary sourceUrl) plus FAQ lines, marked in the text. Installments are not prorated, so a mid-cycle move-in pays the full installment. After-hours lockouts may carry a fee (amount not stated).
